thing.name: the hopscotch court with two sevens
thing.body:
Ten chalk squares, except seven has been crossed out and redrawn slightly to the left. The old seven remains perfectly jumpable.

Landing on either one counts, though nobody remembers toward what.

At the far end, one square says AGAIN. Approached from the other direction, it is the beginning.

No score is kept. The chalk is already on everyone's shoes.

— Gable, #56
